title: Hot tub boat on the canals
description: Rent a wood-fired hot tub boat and cruise the city canals in swimwear. Book a sunset slot.
available_dates: Book slots online, weekends fill fast

title: Rooftop dinner at a food hall
description: Wander a big indoor food market, share small plates from different stalls.

title: Van Gogh Museum + Vondelpark picnic
description: Morning museum slot, then a picnic in the park if the weather cooperates.

title: Escape room challenge
description: Pick a themed escape room neither of you has done. Loser buys dessert.

title: Keukenhof tulip gardens
description: The famous spring gardens. Strictly seasonal, book a morning slot to beat crowds.
available_dates: Open roughly late March to mid May

title: Candlelight concert
description: Classical or pop covers performed by candlelight in a beautiful venue.

title: Beach day + seafood shack
description: Bike or drive to the coast, long beach walk, fresh kibbeling at a strandtent.

title: Giethoorn whisper boat
description: Rent an electric boat and glide through the village with no roads.

title: Cooking workshop for two
description: Learn to make pasta, sushi or dim sum together, then eat your homework.

title: Efteling day
description: Fairy-tale theme park. Go on a weekday, stay for the evening show.

title: Wine tasting at a Dutch vineyard
description: Yes, the Netherlands has vineyards. Tour plus tasting, take a bottle home.

title: Stargazing in a dark sky park
description: Drive out to a dark sky area with blankets, thermos and a stargazing app.
available_dates: New moon nights, clear sky only

title: Thermal spa evening
description: Sauna, pools and rest areas. Check the dress code notes: many Dutch saunas have swimwear days.

title: Film at an art-house cinema
description: Pick a classic or festival film at a gorgeous old cinema, drinks after.

title: Climbing or bouldering intro
description: Try an indoor bouldering hall together, most offer beginner sessions.

title: Utrecht canal kayaking
description: Paddle under the wharf cellars of the Oudegracht at water level.

title: High tea somewhere fancy
description: Three tiers of tiny food and unlimited tea in a chic hotel lounge.

title: Texel island daytrip
description: Ferry across, rent bikes, lighthouse, seal sanctuary, fish lunch.

title: Pottery or paint-your-own ceramics
description: Make something lopsided together, pick it up glazed two weeks later.

title: Open-air theatre or festival picnic
description: Summer-only open air performance with your own picnic basket.

title: Ice skating date
description: Indoor rink in summer, canal or outdoor rink in a real winter.

title: At-home fancy dinner challenge
description: Dress up at home, three courses, each of you secretly cooks one course plus a mystery dessert.

title: Board game cafe night
description: A cafe with hundreds of games and staff who explain them.

title: Sunrise hot air balloon ride
description: Splurge option: balloon flight over the Dutch landscape with toast after landing.
